Private Function Grid(ws As Object) As String
    Dim c As Object, s As String
    For Each c In ws.Range("A1:J9").Cells
        If Not IsEmpty(c.Value) Then s = s & c.Address(0, 0) & "=" & TypeName(c.Value) & ":" & CStr(c.Value) & "/" & c.Formula & " "
    Next
    Grid = s
End Function
